VBO:0201169.summary: Obedient to people, yet difficult to control when fighting other dogs, is how Japan’s polar museum describes the historical Sakhalin sled dog. Expedition dogs gradually learned to work as a team and helped complete a survey journey more than 200 km from Showa Station. Taro and Jiro became famous when the next expedition found them alive in January 1959.
VBO:0201169.shortDescription: Sakhalin sled dogs learned expedition teamwork; the polar museum also records obedience and difficult interdog fights.
